description: Beat peaks of two detuned sawtooths in band envelopes of harmonics 1, 2 and 5.
name: 51-two-saw-peaks

recipe.band: fourth-order Butterworth band-pass of +/- 15 Hz around h f0, run forward and backward
recipe.envelope: magnitude of the analytic signal of the band
recipe.source: sum of two naive sawtooths 2 (f t mod 1) - 1 at f0 and f0 2^(10/1200), phase 0
recipe.spectrum: linear detrend, periodic Hann, 8x zero padding, magnitude FFT; peak bin between 0.2 and 20 Hz, no interpolation
recipe.track: block means of 240 samples, a 200 Hz track

rounding: the issue prints Hz to two decimals
tolerance_note: the rate rule of the issue: within 1 / T, 0.125 Hz for 8 s
